positive_snippets:
Hi everyone,

I would like to share our wonderful experience at Orsom Stays during my daughter’s 1st birthday celebration. A heartfelt thanks to Rahul and his entire team for their exceptional arrangements and warm hospitality. They truly made the occasion special for us and ensured that every guest felt comfortable and happy.

The atmosphere was beautiful, the food was delicious, the cleanliness was excellent, and their attention to detail made the celebration even more memorable.

Highly recommended for family events and special occasions!

Orsom Stays, Sector 53 Gurgaon: A Top-Tier Choice

Orsom Stays in Sector 53, Gurgaon, provides a truly excellent experience for both accommodation and events. The management and staff are noteworthy, consistently delivering good service that is both professional and attentive, ensuring guests feel valued and well taken care of throughout their stay or event.

A standout feature is the immensely spacious banquet hall. This venue is perfect for handling large gatherings—from corporate functions to elaborate weddings—offering ample capacity and a sophisticated ambiance. If you are looking for a venue that combines generous space with reliable, high-quality hospitality, Orsom Stays is highly recommended.
negative_snippets:
My stay at this hotel was a complete disappointment. The rooms were poorly maintained, not clean, and nothing like the pictures shown online. The staff was rude, unhelpful, and showed no sense of responsibility or hospitality. Basic requests were ignored, and their attitude made the entire experience worse. I would never recommend this place to anyone — there are far better options nearby.
